criteria: effect-gouraud-shaded-cube.html is one self-contained file using Canvas 2D (no WebGL): a minimal 3D pipeline (vertices, rotation matrices, perspective projection, backface culling), triangles rasterized with per-vertex Lambert lighting interpolated across each face (Gouraud), a rotating cube, a moving light, a wireframe toggle and pause, and an FPS readout.

review.description: Realtime Gouraud-shaded rotating cube in Canvas 2D (no WebGL): 3D pipeline, triangle rasterizer with per-vertex lighting interpolation, moving light, wireframe toggle, pause, FPS.
